source: Money Rooms v3 spec, Client view: plain-English labels

terms.DRAFTT: Debt, Retirement, Accommodation, Food, Transportation, Therapy: the six shares of your pay
terms.FAT floor: The lean month: food, housing and getting around
terms.Rule of 5: Cash to keep on hand: your age divided by five, in months of spending
terms.FI: Financial independence: when what you own could pay for life
terms.Coast FI: Enough saved today to coast to retirement without adding more
terms.Triple D: Three paths: likely, best and worst returns
terms.Surplus: What is left over each month
terms.Runway: How long your cash would last
terms.Real hourly wage: What an hour of work really pays after everything
